name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
storyline:
A previously-disbanded adventuring party reunites after years apart to go on one last quest together, and it all goes horrifically wrong.

The artifact they were sent to find is missing, old friends are suddenly fighting like bitter enemies, and the party's healer has died under suspicious circumstances. It's up to you to piece together what happened and who is truly to blame.
summary:
Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus is a mystery game centering around a classic adventuring party that have returned from their latest quest only to discover the artifact they were sent to retrieve has vanished from their custody.

Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.
